pages.title: Add
pages.text: Pops two parameters from stack top (both Vec3 or both double), pushes their sum

pages.title: Subtract
pages.text:
Pops two parameters from stack top (both Vec3 or both double), pushes their difference.
First popped is subtrahend, second is minuend

pages.title: Multiply
pages.text: Pops one double and one Vec3, or two doubles from stack top, pushes the product

pages.title: Divide
pages.text: Pops two parameters from stack top, supports:

Two doubles: pushes their quotient (first popped is divisor, second is dividend)
One Vec3 and one double: vector divided by scalar, each component divided by the scalar. If you use this unconventional method, you'll receive a friendly reminder from the mod.
